messages:
Priya (eng-platform): Hey infra/runtime/security — pinging for reviews on PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/7215. This adds a new routing policy and a small infra TF change to reserve ENI attachments for private deploys. Need: infra sign-off on Terraform plan, runtime on KV cache behavior, security on secrets/KMS. Target merge Tue 09:00 UTC (deploy window). Files touched: modules/network.tf, runtime/scheduler/route_selector.cc, infra/vars.tf

Eli (eng-infra): on it. I'll run `terraform plan` tomorrow morning. Quick Q: does this require any in-place resource replacement? If yes we should schedule a migration window. Also can you paste the `terraform plan -target=module.network` output in the PR?

Carlos (eng-runtime): I can review the runtime bits. Can you run a quick perf smoke locally and paste logs? `python scripts/run_perf.py --model=open1-small --seq=128 --batch=1` Concern: KV cache invalidation if route key changes; want to confirm TTL behavior.

Marta (eng-security): Skimming now. Need to confirm secret handling — are we creating new KMS keys? If yes include key policy and audit log scope. Also add a short data-flow note in the PR description about where plaintext tokens might surface (logs, traces).

Priya (eng-platform): Plan output pasted in the PR: 0 to destroy, 3 to create (subnet, ENI, route-table). No replacements. No new KMS keys — we reuse customer-managed key `projects/rdw-kms/keys/redwood-kms`. Perf logs attached in PR comments (Carlos, see linked artifact). Tagging reviewers: @eng-infra/eli @eng-runtime/carlos @eng-security/marta. If approvals come back I'll merge Tue 08:30 UTC to hit the window. :hourglass:

Eli (eng-infra): OK LGTM from infra side. Left one minor terraform var naming nit in the diff (suggest `private_eni_id` -> `private_eni_attachment_id`). :white_check_mark:

Carlos (eng-runtime): Reviewed runtime changes. Left a comment asking to make the cache TTL explicit (default was implicit). After TTL is explicit I'm happy to approve. :thumbsup:

Marta (eng-security): Security review done. Confirmed KMS reuse and that no new key policies are needed. Added audit checklist entry and a note about PIIs in traces. Approve. :shield:

merge-bot: deploy-checks/ci — all checks passed. PR ready to merge.

Priya (eng-platform): Thanks all — merged and scheduled rollout. I'll watch the dashboards during the window and post any anomalies here. :rocket:
